home_hero_subtitle: Talk to the patient, not to the screen. The conversation becomes a structured anamnesis. You only review and approve. Each consultation context is kept for the next one.

mock_cc_evidence: “The pain started suddenly, in the frontal region…”

home_steps_title: From conversation to medical record in three steps
step1_desc: Record the microphone, capture the video call tab, or paste the transcript. Doctor and patient come out separated.
step2_desc: In seconds, the text becomes 8 medical record sections, each with the consultation sentence that grounds it.
step3_desc: Edit whatever you want, check the evidence for each section, confirm, and download the PDF.
home_features_title: Built for the exam room, not the paperwork
feat_trans_desc: KTB captures the consultation audio, stores it, transcribes it, and processes it into a structured draft. The physician uses it as a tool — every field traceable to what was said.
feat_anam_desc: Each field shows the confidence and the source sentences. You review the text without re-listening to the consultation.
feat_review_desc: You edit each section, check the evidence, and approve. Nothing enters the record without your ok.
feat_privacy_desc: Explicit patient consent on every consultation, and the option to run 100% in your environment, with your own model on your GPU.
home_context_note: Every consultation becomes lasting context. The next one already starts with the history on screen.
faq1_q: How is my consultation audio handled?
faq1_a: Audio is captured only after explicit patient consent and is processed to produce the draft. Transcription can run locally or on the server, always under your control; you can also point to your own model (including a local one via Ollama) to keep everything in your environment.
faq2_q: Does the AI diagnose or prescribe?
faq2_a: No. KTB Health generates a structured draft from what was said in the consultation. Each field shows the confidence and the source sentences, and the final record is always reviewed and approved by a physician. KTB is a tool, not a decision-maker: the physician holds total decision.
faq3_q: Does it work for teleconsultations and in-person visits?
faq3_a: Yes. We start with telemedicine because remote capture is simpler: the bot joins Meet, Zoom, Teams, and WhatsApp Web calls, or you can capture the browser tab audio directly. In-person consultations are a core part of the vision — we are extending the same ambient capture to the consultation room.
faq4_a: Every consultation requires an explicit declaration that the patient was informed and consented to the recording. The consent record stays linked to the consultation and the generated anamnesis.
faq5_q: Can I choose which AI model to use?
faq5_a: Yes. Extraction supports Anthropic, OpenAI, Cloudflare Workers AI, local Ollama, and a heuristic fallback engine. The choice is configuration, not code.
